facts.fact: Le Soleil reports the ceremony as the first anniversary of the 'lancement' (launch) of the New Deal technologique, which the Prime Minister said follows from Vision Sénégal 2050; it names no adopting act, and gives no launch date beyond the anniversary in March 2026.
The programme rests on 12 priority projects with an investment portfolio estimated at close to FCFA 1,100 billion between 2025 and 2034.

Among the first decisions was the creation of the digital governance committee GouvNum, charged with coordinating the state's digital projects; a Conseil national du numérique was also installed to advise the state; no act is named.

On 24 March 2026 Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko launched the New Deal's structuring projects at a ceremony marking its first anniversary, including the citizen single window, e-Consulat, sovereign cloud and universal connectivity.

note: Class national: the document describes digitalising the economy and the administration, sovereignty and connectivity. Stated horizon 2034, no text linked, so no period fact.
